name: Joshin Eishi Cryska EX ~Kisama wa, Hontou ni Saitei no Kuzu da na!~
original_name: 女臣衛士クリスカEX ～貴様は、本当に最低の屑だな!～
source:
A short visual novel from Muv Luv universe.
Alpha falls in love with her childhood friend, Eisuke. So she decides to give him a letter. But, things get complicated by not having put his name. A series of misunderstandings and some good sex make this a nice short story.
translation:
Muv Luv宇宙中的一部短篇视觉小说。
阿尔法爱上了她儿时的朋友英介。于是她决定给他写一封信。但是，由于没有留下他的名字，事情变得复杂。一系列的误解和一些美好的性爱使这成为一个不错的短篇故事。
